messages:
nora: quick follow-up to RFC: proposing a lightweight hysteresis + gradual-probe protocol for canaries so we avoid flip-flops when signals bounce.
dan: tl;dr: two-tier hysteresis (soft and hard) + staged probe windows. soft reduces pct, hard blocks variant.
kevin: we should combine with router-side EMA smoothing so actions don't lead to instant pct churn. router keeps short-term EMA per-variant and applies changes over a ramp window.
mira: agree. adjudicator emits actions: {desired_pct, ttl, confidence, reason, hysteresis_level}. router applies ramped delta = EMA(delta, alpha).
ops: telemetry needs: decision.events (level, reason, confidence), probe.attempts, probe.success_rate, applied.ramps. alert when same variant cycles soft->rejoin->soft > 4x/hr.
dan: rejoin scheduling: schedule probes at increasing intervals (linear backoff) and allow one active probe override if current allocation < probe_min_pct. probes can be synthetic or replay; mirror only if redact-enabled.
kevin: config sketch:
```yaml
policy:
  soft_thresholds: {errors: 0.01, p95_ms: 700}
  hard_thresholds: {errors: 0.05}
  soft_eviction_pct: 50
  ramp_window_s: 120
  probe_min_pct: 0.5
  probe_backoff_s: [300,600,1800]
  confidence_floor: 0.6
```
mira: edge case: tenant traffic spikes can create transient false positives. solution: require signal persistence for soft (2 windows) and hard (3 windows). also tie confidence to sample size.
ops: runbook note: when circuit-wide incident active, adjudicator should only emit advisory actions; router ignores automated changes. page if advisory actions exceed threshold.
deploy-bot: canary ab_hy1 scheduled by @nora at 1777654300, variant b @ 2% traffic. check /deploys/ab_hy1 for logs.
nora: next steps: i'll draft the action proto (includes hysteresis_level + confidence + seq), update RFC, and mock console view that shows the hysteresis timeline. sync tomorrow 9:30 if folks can make it.
